article.title: Claims about Manute Bol
article.excerpt: As a child, he may have killed a lion; he quite possibly coined the phrase “my bad”; he certainly warned Congress about Osama bin Laden in 1993. That is from a review of Jordan Conn’s The Defender , a new Kindle Single biography of Manute Bol . I bought my copy right away. There is an explanatory photo here .
